boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct study settings in the shared Claremont Colleges Library, a resource identified by Pitzer as serving 7C students.

cards.entity_name: Open Study Area + Government Docs and Microfilm
cards.title: Open Study Area + Government Docs and Microfilm
cards.subtitle: Mudd 1, Honnold/Mudd Library
cards.notes: Set up among government documents, maps, microfilm, and print collections; use the nearby microfilm reader when your sources require it.
cards.short_summary: An open study area integrated with government-document and print collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies Mudd 1 as open study space alongside government documents, maps, microfilm, and print book collections.
cards.access_notes: Enter with a current Claremont Colleges ID card; other visitors must check in at a service desk.

cards.title: Collaborative Commons
cards.subtitle: Honnold 2 North, Honnold/Mudd Library
cards.notes: Bring a charged laptop or use the Power Bar, then choose modular seating, pivoting-table chairs, or a media:scape table for collaboration.
cards.short_summary: Flexible open seating with charging and media:scape tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Collaborative Commons is an open study area with modular seating, pivoting-table chairs, media:scape tables, and a Power Bar.
cards.access_notes: Enter with a current Claremont Colleges ID card; other visitors must check in at a service desk.

cards.title: Glass Bridge & Treadmill Desks
cards.subtitle: Between Honnold and Mudd, second floor
cards.notes: Use a treadmill desk when you want a change of posture; the glass bridge connects both library sides and has treetop campus views.
cards.short_summary: Treadmill desks in the library’s glass bridge.
cards.evidence_claim: The library places treadmill desks in the glass bridge between Honnold and Mudd and notes their treetop campus views.
cards.access_notes: Enter with a current Claremont Colleges ID card; other visitors must check in at a service desk.

cards.title: Digital Scholarship Collaboratory
cards.subtitle: Mudd 2 South, Honnold/Mudd Library
cards.notes: Choose this open area for projects needing dual monitors, the data-visualization panel, or the listed software suites; bring files ready to work.
cards.short_summary: An open study area with high-performance digital tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The Digital Scholarship Collaboratory is an open study area with dual monitors, a data visualization panel, and software suites.
cards.access_notes: Enter with a current Claremont Colleges ID card; other visitors must check in at a service desk.

cards.title: Study Cubes
cards.subtitle: Mudd 2 North & South, Honnold/Mudd Library
cards.notes: Use a semi-private cube for solo work or a small group session; the library specifies that these cubes do not require a reservation.
cards.short_summary: Semi-private individual or group-study cubes without reservations.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Cubes in Mudd 2 North and South are semi-private for individual or group study, and reservation is not required.
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required. Enter with a current Claremont Colleges ID card; other visitors must check in.

cards.title: Solarium
cards.subtitle: Mudd 2 East, Honnold/Mudd Library
cards.notes: Use the tables and charging ports in natural light, then move to the adjacent outdoor patio when its shaded tables suit your work.
cards.short_summary: A light-filled study space with charging and a shaded patio.
cards.evidence_claim: The Solarium is open study space with natural light, study tables, charging ports, and an outdoor patio with shaded tables.
cards.access_notes: Enter with a current Claremont Colleges ID card; other visitors must check in at a service desk.

cards.title: Mudd 3 Bridge Open Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Mudd 3 Bridge, Honnold/Mudd Library
cards.notes: Choose a table or chair on the bridge when you want natural light and treetop views while remaining in an open study area.
cards.short_summary: Open bridge seating with daylight and treetop views.
cards.evidence_claim: Mudd 3 Bridge is an open study area with tables, chairs, natural light, and treetop views.
cards.access_notes: Enter with a current Claremont Colleges ID card; other visitors must check in at a service desk.

cards.title: Honnold & Mudd 3 Open Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Honnold/Mudd Library
cards.notes: Pick from modular desks and tables across the third-floor open areas; use this option when you need flexible seating rather than a room.
cards.short_summary: Third-floor open areas with modular desks and tables.
cards.evidence_claim: The library describes open study areas on Honnold and Mudd 3 as having open seating with modular desks and tables.
cards.access_notes: Enter with a current Claremont Colleges ID card; other visitors must check in at a service desk.

cards.title: Quiet Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Honnold 4 North & South, Honnold/Mudd Library
cards.notes: Head to Honnold’s fourth floor for open seating with modular tables when you need an area the library designates for minimal noise distraction.
cards.short_summary: Fourth-floor quiet seating designed to limit distraction.
cards.evidence_claim: Honnold 4 North and South quiet study areas provide open seating, modular tables, and minimal noise distraction.
cards.access_notes: Enter with a current Claremont Colleges ID card; other visitors must check in at a service desk.

cards.title: Study Room 406
cards.subtitle: Honnold 4, Honnold/Mudd Library
cards.notes: Reserve this enclosed group-study room when your session benefits from whiteboards and a short-throw projector; collect access details from the library.
cards.short_summary: An enclosed Honnold 4 group-study room with projection.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 406 is an enclosed Honnold 4 group-study room with whiteboards and a short-throw projector.
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are available to current students, faculty, and staff and require a reservation; enter the building with a current ID.
